name: Elisha
title: Elijah's Successor
summary: Elisha was the prophet who succeeded Elijah and performed twice as many miracles as his master. He is known for healings, miraculous food provision, and political influence over the kings of Israel and Aram.

keyEvents.title: The Call to Service
keyEvents.description: Elijah cast his cloak over Elisha while he was plowing, and Elisha left everything to follow him.

keyEvents.title: The Double Portion of the Spirit
keyEvents.description: Elisha asked for a double portion of Elijah's spirit, and received it when he saw Elijah taken up into heaven.

keyEvents.title: The Widow's Oil
keyEvents.description: Elisha helped a prophet's widow by miraculously filling all her jars with oil.

keyEvents.title: The Shunammite's Son
keyEvents.description: Elisha promised a childless woman a son, and when the boy later died, Elisha raised him from the dead.

keyEvents.title: Naaman's Healing
keyEvents.description: Elisha healed the Aramean commander Naaman of leprosy by telling him to bathe seven times in the Jordan.
